plan.title: Single-stage RFQ upload with bad row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the default event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title before interacting with the create flow.
Select the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Select the specified product in the first Product cell.
Confirm the requested product was selected.
Confirm the product selection filled the mapped default variant.
Confirm the delivery location was selected.
Upload the closest available CSV fixture through the product sheet's upload control.
Assert the upload reports one failed entry, as specified.
Assert the failed-row inspection control is offered.
